settings.headline: How to start with the firm
settings.subtitle: There is no sign-up form. Call the front desk or stop by, and we book a free thirty-minute first meeting.

settings.headline: Four steps
settings.intro: From the first call to the first return, usually two to three weeks.

items.title: Call or stop by
items.text: (555) 017-4400, weekdays 8:30 to 5, or 14 Wharf Street (fictional). We ask a few questions and book a first meeting.

items.title: A free first meeting
items.text: Thirty minutes with the person who would do your work. Bring last year's return and your questions.

items.title: An engagement letter
items.text: A written scope and a fixed fee. You sign it by e-signature, and we open your client portal.

items.title: Your portal and organizer
items.text: Upload documents against the checklist. We start when the organizer is complete.

settings.headline: When to call
settings.body: We take new individual clients until February 15 for the current season; after that we file an extension and finish the return after April. New business clients are welcome any month, and the best time to start monthly books is the first month of a quarter.
settings.memo: (555) 017-4400 · Weekdays 8:30 to 5 · 14 Wharf Street, Merrow Bend (fictional)
